tool_args.rationale: The verified source note and pilot signatures support the siphon base with an open positive-or-negative square-root branch. Five varied rows identify its three parameters, so no paid probe is warranted. The fit numerically estimates vmax, rho, and c_loc within the provided fallback bounds; predict uses the fitted parameters rather than refitting a prediction row.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The five pilot rows span s_grad=0.35–2.34 and identify the three parameters of the source-matched square-root branch; another measurement is not needed.
No observed high-frequency or temporal instability; the forecast horizon is already represented in the pilots and the matched mechanism is an algebraic readout.
The observed response is monotone increasing and concave over the measured u_now range, unlike the source-described high-u decline.
The supplied mechanism/signatures specifically support the siphon base and open square-root branch; the pilot saturation pattern is not a power-law response.
